Overview

Blockchain & Digital Trust for Public Sector & Government earns its budget only when it changes a number on someone's scorecard. So we invert the usual sequence: lock the metric and its baseline first, then work backwards to the smallest architecture that moves it — usually composed from case & benefits platforms and the tower platform rather than built from scratch. Public Sector & Government punishes generic deployments. service standards moves faster than batch cycles, GDPR / privacy regimes demands evidence chains most tools cannot produce, and the estate is heterogeneous — which is why every engagement starts with the seams named above rather than a platform-first rollout.

blocks.x: Engineering standards & stack

items: on-chain/off-chain split
What must be tamper-evident goes on ledger; the bulk stays off it, linked and provable.
hash-linked anchoring
Records anchored by hash so tampering is detectable — trust with a checksum.
HSM key ceremonies
Key generation and rotation performed under ceremony, with the evidence auditors require.
notarized audit exports
Evidence exports sealed so nobody can quietly edit last quarter's numbers.

blocks.x: Failure modes & the guards we ship
Failure modes we design against, with the guard shipped for each:

items: Ledger worship
The ledger used where tamper-evidence earns its cost — everything else stays a database with a backup.
On-chain PII
Personal data never written on-ledger — hashes and references only, verified in design review.
Key fragility
Keys rotated on ceremony with HSM custody — the compromise of one secret is never the compromise of the estate.
